t_advice_summary_textbox.text: taller hats give more points intially but colours also matter, make sure to switch it up after 4th break

vb_textbox.text: I didnt agree with the advice given about the taller pink hats offering more points than the tall blue ones. Same goes for the small Green offering more points than the small orange. My advice would be its pot luck, pick a side, right or left and keep a thumb on the space bar and remember to hit it.
